title: [Classic Long-Form RPG] Estimating Work Hours for Placing Townspeople and Remaining Tasks

blocks.source: 【王道長編RPG】町人配置と残作業の工数見積
blocks.translation: [Classic Long-Form RPG] Estimating Work Hours for Placing Townspeople and Remaining Tasks

blocks.source: 遅ればせながら、あけおめ！
blocks.translation: Belatedly, Happy New Year!

blocks.source: ……と言っても今更な上に、初詣も行かない不信心者なので、年末年始もゲーム制作ばかりの平常運転ですが。
blocks.translation: Though I say that, it’s already rather late, and I’m irreligious enough not to visit a shrine for New Year’s, so I’ve spent the year-end and New Year period working on the game as usual.

blocks.source: 町人配置
blocks.translation: Placing Townspeople

blocks.source: 前回、講座に書いたような町人の配置＆セリフ入力をひたすらやっていました。しかしこれ、人数が多くなるに連れて、管理が大変になっていきますね。
blocks.translation: Last time, I spent all my time placing townspeople and entering their dialogue, as described in the guide. However, the more people there are, the more difficult they become to manage.

blocks.source: 同じようなセリフを書いていないか？
blocks.translation: Have I written any similar lines of dialogue?

blocks.source: 同じ人物の口調や内容が一貫しているか？
blocks.translation: Are each character’s speech patterns and content consistent?

blocks.source: 必要な情報が抜け落ちていないか？
blocks.translation: Have I left out any necessary information?

blocks.source: 誤字・脱字などないか？
blocks.translation: Are there any typos or omissions?

blocks.source: 色んなことを気にせねばなりません。そこで、これも表で管理するようにしたところ、なかなか良い感じです。
blocks.translation: There are all sorts of things to keep in mind. So I started managing this in a spreadsheet as well, and it’s working quite nicely.

blocks.source: 右列に物語の進行に応じて変化した会話を記入するようにしています。色変えしている箇所はまだ未入力の部分です。もちろん、１町＝１シートで管理します。
blocks.translation: I enter dialogue that changes as the story progresses in the right-hand column. The color-coded sections are parts that haven’t been entered yet. Naturally, I manage one town per sheet.

blocks.source: 上に列挙した以外にも……
blocks.translation: In addition to those listed above…

blocks.source: どれだけのセリフ入力が残っているか？
blocks.translation: How much dialogue entry remains?

blocks.source: 固い文章・説明文ばかりになっていないか？
blocks.translation: Has it become nothing but stiff writing and exposition?

blocks.source: 全体の会話内容を合わせると、どのような印象を受けるか？
blocks.translation: What impression do you get from the dialogue as a whole?

blocks.source: 全体として、どれだけの量を入力したか？
blocks.translation: How much have I entered overall?

blocks.source: テキストエディタにコピペすれば、文字数確認も可能。
blocks.translation: Pasting it into a text editor also makes it possible to check the character count.

blocks.source: といったことが、一目瞭然なので便利。マジオススメです。既に入力済みだったセリフを表に移すのが若干面倒でしたが、そこはまあ……。
blocks.translation: It’s convenient because things like that are immediately obvious. I highly recommend it. Moving dialogue that had already been entered into the spreadsheet was a little tedious, but, well…

blocks.source: ちなみに表計算ソフトはお金をケチってOpenOfficeのCalcを使用しています。昔、OpenOfficeは重くて起動に数分かかったりで、使い物にならない印象があったのですが、今のＰＣのスペックならなんてことはないですね。もちろん、Excelがあるなら、Excelでよいですが。
blocks.translation: Incidentally, I’m using OpenOffice Calc as my spreadsheet software to save money. I used to think OpenOffice was unusable because it was so slow and took several minutes to start up, but with my current PC’s specs, it’s no problem at all. Of course, if you have Excel, Excel is fine too.

blocks.source: 残作業の工数見積
blocks.translation: Estimating Work Hours for Remaining Tasks

blocks.source: そろそろ完成を見据えねばなりません。目指すは年内の完成！ というわけで、年末の連休に入る前に、残作業を見積もってみました。
blocks.translation: I need to start looking toward completion soon. The goal is to finish within the year! So, before the year-end holiday break, I tried estimating the remaining work.

blocks.source: キャラグラ：１５０時間
blocks.translation: Character graphics: 150 hours

blocks.source: マップ：５０時間
blocks.translation: Maps: 50 hours

blocks.source: ストーリー：７０時間
blocks.translation: Story: 70 hours

blocks.source: 魔物データ：１５０時間
blocks.translation: Monster data: 150 hours

blocks.source: 装備・技データ：１００時間
blocks.translation: Equipment and skill data: 100 hours

blocks.source: 戦闘アニメ：１００時間
blocks.translation: Battle animations: 100 hours

blocks.source: テストプレイ：１００時間
blocks.translation: Playtesting: 100 hours

blocks.source: 一周するだけで３０時間は覚悟する必要がありそう。
blocks.translation: It looks like I’ll need to allow 30 hours just to complete one playthrough.

blocks.source: 町人配置：９０時間
blocks.translation: Placing townspeople: 90 hours

blocks.source: などなど……。色々と積み重なって見積結果、残り約１０００時間。多っ！ しかも、まだまだ漏れがあったり、必要な作業が増えたりする可能性大。
blocks.translation: And so on… Once everything was added up, the estimate came to approximately 1,000 hours remaining. That’s a lot! What’s more, there’s a strong possibility that I’ve still overlooked things or that additional tasks will arise.

blocks.source: ストーリーもマップもほぼ完成しているのに、なんでこんなにかかるのかと。１０００時間もあれば、やり方次第では長編一つ完成できそうな気がします。
blocks.translation: Even though the story and maps are nearly complete, why is it taking so long? With 1,000 hours, it feels like I could complete an entire long-form RPG, depending on how I went about it.

blocks.source: 何て言ってる内に一応、年末～今までで１７０時間程度の作業を既に消化しましたが、果たして本当に終わるんでしょうか？ とはいえ、これで終わりの見えない感じがだいぶ軽減されのも確かです。もっとも、クオリティを削ってまで納期を厳守するつもりはありませんけれど、あくまで目安ということで。
blocks.translation: In the meantime, I’ve already completed about 170 hours of work from the end of the year through now, but will I really be able to finish? Even so, it’s true that this has greatly reduced the feeling that the end is nowhere in sight. That said, I have no intention of meeting a deadline at the expense of quality; this is merely a guideline.
